decision_description: The constitutional compliance check of docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase8_drafting_review/drafting_review_status.json (run_id d0675cf5-4c10-4bb9-a949-643c96bcec2a) identified a critical §13.8 violation and three major supporting violations. §13.8 (critical): All three Part B proposal sections (excellence, impact, implementation) are declared status='final' with data_gaps_flagged=false in section_completion_log, while revision_actions A-2 (major severity), A-9 (minor), and A-10 (minor) each explicitly cite confirmed missing Tier 3 source data — respectively the fellow's publication record and peer-recognition evidence, ELTE's active GEP URL and HRS4R label confirmation, and ELTE's institution-level research capacity data (Horizon Europe grant history, ERA network memberships, international partnerships, FAIR data policy). Revision_log entries L-2, L-9, and L-10 record 'No content change; dispositioned unresolved' for these three actions without updating the affected proposal section files to carry inline [DATA REQUIRED: ...] markers and without setting data_gaps_flagged=true. CLAUDE.md §13.8 prohibits finalizing proposal text when source state is known to be incomplete without explicitly flagging the gap in the deliverable; this prohibition is violated by the current state of all three section artifacts and the section_completion_log. §13.2 (major): Revision_actions assert MSCA-PF evaluation sub-criteria obligations (A-1 'mandatory Excellence sub-criterion', A-3 'MSCA mandatory dimension', A-9 'satisfies the hosting arrangements sub-criterion in the evaluation form') without any traceability_footer primary_sources reference to docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/. §13.3 (major): Project-specific names and identifiers (AgroVIR, Dr. Rositsa Cholakova, Dr. András Jung, Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE), WP1 Task T1-03, D4-01, RQ5, RQ9, Bayesian hierarchical model, Multisensor-Drone-Fusion Working Group) appear in revision_actions without Tier 3 source traceability; the artifact carries no traceability_footer field. §13.9 (major): Horizon Europe regulatory obligations (GEP requirement at grant signature, MSCA mandatory dimensions) are asserted in revision_actions without Tier 1 normative framework source references. All four violations are unresolved. Human operator action is required before any of the three proposal sections may legitimately carry status='final': either the missing Tier 3 data must be supplied and the section content revised, or the section files must be updated with inline gap markers for each confirmed missing data item and data_gaps_flagged set to true in the section_completion_log.
alternatives_considered: Treat the compliance check artifact's embedded decision_log_entries[] array as sufficient durable record and omit a standalone entry to docs/tier4_orchestration_state/decision_log/ — rejected because CLAUDE.md §9.4 requires every decision affecting traceability or reproducibility to be written to the decision_log directory; embedded arrays within validation report artifacts do not satisfy this constitutional requirement and the violation would be held only in the validation report's in-document structure.

Declare resolution_status=resolved on the basis that the compliance check itself constitutes the required recording act — rejected because the §13.8 violation itself (sections declared final with unresolved data gaps not flagged inline) remains substantively unresolved regardless of whether it has been recorded; the recording act is separate from and does not discharge the underlying obligation to revise the deliverables.

Log only the §13.8 critical violation as the decision entry and treat §13.2, §13.3, and §13.9 as informational findings not requiring a durable log entry — rejected because all four are independently enumerated §13 prohibitions whose violation each affects future interpretability and traceability of the proposal artifact set; consolidating all four into a single entry is permissible and preferable to omitting the subordinate violations from the durable record.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §13.8 — primary constitutional prohibition governing finalization of proposal text when source state is known to be incomplete without explicitly flagging the gap; CLAUDE.md §13.2 — prohibition on asserting call constraints not traceable to Tier 2B source documents; CLAUDE.md §13.3 — prohibition on asserting project facts not present in Tier 3; CLAUDE.md §13.9 — prohibition on substituting agent-local programme knowledge for Tier 1 source documents when those documents are present; CLAUDE.md §9.4 — every decision affecting future interpretation, traceability, or reproducibility must be written to docs/tier4_orchestration_state/decision_log/
rationale: The drafting_review_status.json artifact records data_gaps_flagged=false and status=final for all three proposal sections while simultaneously recording that revision_actions A-2, A-9, and A-10 are status=unresolved with explicit §13.3 citations explaining that resolution requires data absent from the declared Tier 3 input set. The revision_log entries L-2, L-9, and L-10 confirm no content changes were made to the section files and no gap markers were applied. This creates a direct contradiction between the section_completion_log's finality declaration and the revision_actions' confirmed data-gap records. CLAUDE.md §13.8 is unambiguous and unconditional: proposal text must not be finalized when source state is known to be incomplete, contradictory, or unvalidated without explicitly flagging the gap in the deliverable. The three confirmed missing data items — fellow publication record (A-2), ELTE GEP/HRS4R compliance data (A-9), ELTE institutional research capacity data (A-10) — constitute known incomplete source state. The constitutional compliance check report (docs/tier4_orchestration_state/validation_reports/constitutional-compliance-check_d0675cf5.json) characterised the §13.8 violation as critical severity. This decision log entry is required per CLAUDE.md §9.4 to ensure the violation finding and required resolution are durably recorded in Tier 4 and not held only in agent memory or embedded solely within a validation report artifact. The resolution_status is unresolved because the underlying proposal section artifacts remain in a state that violates §13.8 until either the missing Tier 3 data is supplied and sections revised, or inline data-gap markers are applied and section completion status is corrected.
